1.context: From Friday evening to early Sunday morning spans only about 36 to 40 hours, well short of three full days and nights. The synoptic gospels all describe Jesus rising on the third day, but with notable differences in phrasing. Mark 8:31 refers to rising after three days, suggesting a longer period. As I mentioned, Matthew 12 40 explicitly mentions three days and three nights, contradicting the inclusive reckoning typically applied. Luke 24 21 records the disciples lamenting on Sunday.
